pipeline_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/visual-workbench
source /workspace/.vw-tools/cloud-setup/start.sh
cargo deny --offline check licenses sources bans
bash apps/gradlew -p apps checkDependencyLicenses --console=plain --no-daemon --no-parallel --max-workers=2
cargo test --locked -p vw-document-protocol -- --test-threads=2
cargo build --locked -p vw-ffi -p vw-host-ffi --features vw-ffi/bindgen --lib --bin vw-bindgen
cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a --platform 29 -o target/android-jni build --locked -p vw-ffi
# Focused Linux-host tests compile the actual apps. The Windows-only desktop
# helper resource task is excluded only here; product packaging remains untested.
bash apps/gradlew -p apps \
  :shared:desktopTest --tests com.visualworkbench.shared.DiagnosticsBundleTest \
  --tests com.visualworkbench.shared.DocumentJobsOwnerTest \
  --tests com.visualworkbench.shared.DocumentFramesTest \
  --tests com.visualworkbench.shared.OriginalFormatsTest \
  :desktop:test --tests com.visualworkbench.desktop.DesktopDiagnosticsLifecycleTest \
  --tests com.visualworkbench.desktop.diagnostics.DiagnosticsPublicationTest \
  :android:testDebugUnitTest --tests com.visualworkbench.android.diagnostics.DiagnosticReportWriterTest \
  :android:lintDebug -x :desktop:packageConnectionRuntime \
  --console=plain --no-daemon --no-parallel --max-workers=2
